outcome: Prevention or delay of severe anaemia
cohort: The paper discusses the management of haemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (HDFN) in pregnant women at very high risk of early-onset HDFN and their babies.
finding: This paper discusses the evidence, risks, and benefits of novel therapies, such as intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG), for the management of haemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (HDFN) in high-risk pregnancies.
